details: Refuted.  The three-code class has $\mathrm{Ldim}=1$ and $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}=2$.  The cited twofold-monotonicity statement does not yield a bound by the maximum-over-subclasses projected teaching quantity used here.
proof: The three-code class $\{000,011,101\}$ has no complete Littlestone tree of depth two, hence $\mathrm{Ldim}=1$.  On the other hand, omitting a different coordinate makes each target the middle of a three-trace path, so its minimum projected teaching-set size is two and therefore $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}=2$.  Hence $\mathrm{Ldim}<\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}$.
name: Littlestone Dimension / Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
